sections.heading: HOW TO APPROACH IT
sections.body: Core should use curated cards or an approved read-only feed that points to the Wix blog canonical URLs. Do not copy article bodies, invent publication dates or create a competing CMS.

sections.heading: YOUR NEXT MOVE
sections.body: Follow the original article for its sources, date, category and any subsequent updates. The same published work can appear as a contextual card on Core and on specialist sites while the original article body stays with its Wix canonical URL.
